Taxonomic_Notes: Multiple competing Elaeis forms remain in the canonical 127 inventory: Elaeis guineensis, Elaeis guinensis, and Elaeis guineense. No silent assignment made.
Macaranga barteri exists in the canonical inventory, but Macaranga barteri and Micranga barteri occur as separate historical structural records. Automatic consolidation would therefore be unsafe.
No supported canonical equivalent identified. Similarity to Pavetta corymbosa/corymbosia is insufficient for taxonomic consolidation.
